[[File:Piotr Szczęsny (Upamiętnienie; Plac Defilad w Warszawie) 02.jpg|thumb|The place in Warsaw where Piotr Szczęsny set himself on fire]]
[[File:2017 Warszawa Piotr Szczęsny miejsce pamięci, tablica.jpeg|thumb|Memorial plaque next to the official gallery of the Palace of Culture:<br /> "I, an ordinary, grey person"]]
'''Piotr Paweł Szczęsny''' (6 July 1963, [[Kraków]] &ndash; 29 October 2017, [[Warsaw]]) was a Polish chemist and a [[Mensa International|Mensa]] member who committed [[Self-immolation|suicide by immolation]] in protest against the policies of the ruling [[Law and Justice (Poland)|Law and Justice]] government.

== Education and career ==
He studied chemistry at [[Jagiellonian University]] and became a member of the [[Independent Students' Union]]. He worked in the 1980s in the "[[Solidarność]]" union federation. After graduation, he remained as an assistant at the university, and began his doctoral thesis. After 1989, he left the university and became co-founder of a publishing house, which edited manuals on chemistry. For ten years, he held the post of Chairman of a Society for Continuing Vocational Training. He worked as a consultant on business issues. In 2016 he closed his company.
== Self-immolation ==
He burned himself as a sign of political protest. On 19 October 2017, he entered the [[Parade Square]] in front of the [[Palace of Culture and Science]], played the song {{Ill|Kocham wolność|pl|Kocham_wolno%C5%9B%C4%87}},<ref>{{Cite news |date=2017-10-20 |title=Pole attempts self-immolation in likely anti-govt protest |url=https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/pole-attempts-self-immolation-in-likely-anti-govt-protest |access-date=2024-10-21 |work=The Straits Times |language=en |issn=0585-3923}}</ref> distributed copies of a self-produced leaflet, poured flammable liquid over himself and set himself on fire.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oko.press/mezczyzna-podpalil-przy-dzwiekach-piosenki-wolnosci-oddac-umiem-relacja-pauliny-piechny-wieckiewicz/|title=Mężczyzna podpalił się przy dźwiękach piosenki "Wolności oddać nie umiem". Relacja radnej Pauliny Piechny-Więckiewicz|last=Szczęśniak|first=Agata|date=2017-10-19|newspaper=[[OKO.press]]|language=pl|access-date=2017-11-03}}</ref> He died in the [[:pl:Szpital_Kliniczny_Dzieciątka_Jezus|hospital]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Wyborcza.pl |url=https://warszawa.wyborcza.pl/warszawa/7,54420,22580825,nie-zyje-piotr-s-mezczyzna-ktory-podpalil-sie-pod-palacem.html |access-date=2024-02-23 |website=warszawa.wyborcza.pl}}</ref> ten days later.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://tvnwarszawa.tvn24.pl/informacje,news,znicze-przed-palacem-kultury-ku-pamieci-piotra-s,245334.html|title=Znicze przed Pałacem Kultury. Ku pamięci Piotra S.|date=2017-11-02|publisher=tvnwarszawa.pl|language=pl|access-date=2017-11-03}}</ref> Following Szczęsny's death, the government media declared him mentally unstable.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Nalepa|first1=Monika|title=As Poland's nationalists take the spotlight, notice the protesters|url=http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/opinion/commentary/ct-perspec-poland-independence-day-march-szczesny-1117-20171116-story.html|work=chicagotribune.com}}</ref>{{Better citation needed|reason=Source restricted in EU.|date=February 2025}} Piotr Szczęsny was buried on 14 November 2017 at the Kraków [[Salwator Cemetery]] in the presence of thousands of mourners from all over Poland.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-11-14 |title=Pogrzeb Piotra Szczęsnego w Krakowie. "Upomniał się o sprawy ważne dla nas wszystkich" |url=https://krakow.wyborcza.pl/krakow/7,44425,22643695,pogrzeb-piotra-szczesnego-w-krakowie-upomnial-sie-o-sprawy.html |access-date=2021-08-12 |publisher=krakow.wyborcza.pl |language=pl}}</ref>

Szczęsny lived in [[Niepołomice]]; his wife is a pharmacist and their two children were studying for their doctorates.<ref name=Pacewicz1>{{Cite web |url=https://oko.press/dlaczego-sie-podpalil-zona-przepelnila-sie-ta-czara-corka-boje-sie-ze-pokaza-tate-jako-wariata-umniejsza-motywacje/ |title=Dlaczego się podpalił? Żona: "Jak bardzo przepełniła się ta czara!". Córka: "Boję się, że pokażą tatę jako wariata i umniejszą jego motywację" |last=Pacewicz |first=Piotr |newspaper=[[OKO.press]] |date=2017-10-20 |language=pl |access-date=2017-11-03}}</ref> He was not involved in any political action of the Polish opposition and had suffered from depression for the last eight years of his life.<ref name=Pacewicz1 /> In a letter to his family, he stated that his deed was not motivated by his condition.<ref name=Chelminski1>{{Cite web|url=http://warszawa.wyborcza.pl/warszawa/7,54420,22580825,nie-zyje-piotr-s-mezczyzna-ktory-podpalil-sie-pod-palacem.html|title=Nie żyje Piotr S., który podpalił się pod Pałacem Kultury|date=2017-10-29|publisher=warszawa.wyborcza.pl|language=pl|access-date=2017-11-07}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://wyborcza.pl/7,75398,22593834,2-listopada-w-warszawie-zaplona-znicze-dla-piotr-s.html |title=Dziś w Warszawie zapłoną znicze dla Piotra Szczęsnego. W poniedziałek milczący marsz |publisher=wyborcza.pl |date=2017-11-01 |language=pl |access-date=2017-11-04}}</ref> Szczęsny's suicide received considerable publicity and a march held to honour him was attended by several hundred people.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Pempel|first1=Kacper|title=March in Poland mourns man who set himself on fire in...|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-politics-protests/march-in-poland-mourns-man-who-set-himself-on-fire-in-anti-government-protest-idUSKBN1D62DO|work=U.S.}}</ref>
